# Complete Guide to DeepSeek Models (BentoML)
<https://www.bentoml.com/blog/the-complete-guide-to-deepseek-models-from-v3-to-r1-and-beyond>
`content_hash: 0d85aee7dd785ea5476fed76af3df69f99db82e70e91c972665a008857eae5f4`

区分：V3=通用基座(架构+预训练), R1=RL推理特化(后训练), V3.1/V3.2=混合thinking统一两者。'架构+预训练'适用V3，但泛化推理(R1)恰来自后训练。
